pages.text: Spin a coil in a magnet's field and it drives a current: ε = NBAω. With the same coil and load, the power goes as ε², so a magnet three times stronger gives about ten times the power.

The $(item)Induction Generator$() burns fuel to spin its coil. Put a magnet in its second slot - a Ferrite Magnet gives 24 FE/t, Samarium-Cobalt 180, Neodymium 250 - and flowing water beside it, like a water wheel, adds half again for every side.
